# Gamified Industrial Learning Platform

Serious Games for Safer, Faster, and More Engaging Workforce Training

# **Executive Summary**

Antiz’s Gamified Learning Platform is a cloud-based SaaS solution that uses interactive serious games to improve industrial training outcomes. Trainers assign topic-based learning games to trainees, track engagement, and automatically generate completion certificates. The platform makes safety and operational training more engaging, measurable, and scalable than traditional classroom methods.

# **The Problem**

Industrial training is often delivered through presentations or lectures that are difficult to scale and even harder to measure. Organizations struggle to ensure engagement, retention, and practical application of safety and operational practices.

# **The Solution**

The platform converts industrial learning topics into scenario-based games where learners identify hazards, answer questions, and improve scores through repeated attempts. Trainers distribute games through simple email tokens, enabling scalable digital training.

# **Target Audience**

\- Safety and EHS Trainers  
\- Industrial Training Consultants  
\- Manufacturing and Plant Training Managers  
\- Learning & Development Teams  
\- Technical Institutes and Training Providers

# **Key Benefits**

• Higher engagement through interactive gameplay  
• Practical learning using realistic workplace scenarios  
• Built-in scoring and certification  
• Scalable digital training distribution

# **Scenario Game Catalog (Examples)**

| Training Module | Learning Objective |
| :---- | :---- |
| Safety Basics | Foundational safety awareness |
| PPE Usage | Correct protective equipment selection |
| Chemical Handling Safety | Safe chemical handling and storage |
| Material Handling Safety | Safe movement of materials |
| Working at Height Safety | Awareness of height-related risks |
| Electrical Safety | Recognizing electrical hazards |
| Confined Space Safety | Safe entry and work practices |
| Compressed Air Safety | Safe industrial air usage |
| 5S Shopfloor Clean-Up Race | Workplace organization practices |
| Campus Road Safety | Safe movement within industrial campuses |

# **Core Platform Features**

• Game catalog with topic-based training modules  
• Partner dashboard for trainers  
• Token-based game distribution via email  
• Timed access with repeat play attempts  
• Automatic score tracking and certification  
• Flexible partner and enterprise deployment models

# **Partner Workflow**

Partners browse the catalog, select training modules, and send access tokens to trainees. Trainees complete the assigned game, improve their scores during the validity period, and receive a certificate reflecting their highest score.

![][image1]

# **Token, Certification & Billing Model**

Each trainee receives a unique token tied to a training module. The token activates on first use and allows multiple attempts within a fixed time window. After expiry, the platform issues a completion certificate based on the learner’s highest score. Organizations are billed based on training usage.
